title: Explain possible change impact through engineering paths
statement: The system shall identify entities potentially affected by a proposed change using explicitly selected relationship scope in one model state, and associate each reported impact with its supporting path while stating uncertainty and traversal limits.

what.problem: An impact list without its relation to the proposed change can hide omissions or be mistaken for proven behavioral effects.
what.desired_outcome: A participant can inspect why an entity may require review and distinguish potential impact from a confirmed consequence.

why.rationale: IR-002 requires assessable effects of proposed changes while limiting graph analysis to declared relationships and one selected state.

conditions: When a participant investigates the possible effects of changing selected engineering entities.

contexts: Within the selected project model state and relationship scope.

how.approach: Use the changed-entity selection and declared influence directions to expose reachable entities and a supporting typed path for each. Carry through missing-reference, requested-limit, and interruption diagnostics and identify uncovered domains. Leave the effect judgment to the responsible engineering assessment.

how_much.scope: Covers relationship-based potential impact. It does not infer unrecorded dependencies, predict code behavior, approve a change, or establish the required verification set by graph reachability alone.

acceptance_criteria: For each potentially affected entity, present the selected change subject and at least one supporting typed path in the selected state.
Respect the requested relationship types and influence directions; do not silently broaden the selected scope or include unrelated entities as established impact.
Where no entity is reachable in a fully assessed scope, report no relationship-based impact in that scope without claiming the change has no real-world effects.
Carry limited or incomplete traversal status into the impact result and identify the omitted or unresolved scope.
Label the result as potential impact for review; a reachable Evidence or Implementation reference does not establish invalidation or behavior change by itself.

sources.basis: Derived from IR-002 and its selected initial-profile scope: IR-002 requires assessable effects of proposed changes while limiting graph analysis to declared relationships and one selected state.
